title: Near-Quadratic Sample Compression for All VC Classes
abstract: arXiv:2611.25011v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The sample compression conjecture is a longstanding open problem in learning theory, originating in the work of Littlestone and Warmuth in the 1980s. At its heart is a connection between simplification and generalization: if a predictor consistent with a training sample is defined using only a small part of that sample, then it is likely to generalize. Sample compression schemes formalize this idea, and many natural learning algorithms can be analyzed this way.   The sample compression conjecture of Floyd and Warmuth (1995) asserts that every binary concept class of VC dimension $d$ admits a sample compression scheme of size $O(d)$; a weaker conjecture asks only for size polynomial in $d$. Both have remained open: the first bound depending only on $d$, due to Moran and Yehudayoff (2016), is exponential in $d$. We prove the weaker conjecture by constructing a sample compression scheme of size $O(d^2 \log^2 d)$.

translated_title: 所有VC类的近二次样本压缩
translated_abstract: 样本压缩猜想是学习理论中一个长期悬而未决的问题，起源于Littlestone和Warmuth在20世纪80年代的工作。其核心在于简化与泛化之间的联系：如果一个与训练样本一致的预测器仅通过该样本的一小部分来定义，那么它很可能具有泛化能力。样本压缩方案将这一思想形式化，许多自然的学习算法都可以通过这种方式进行分析。Floyd和Warmuth（1995）提出的样本压缩猜想断言，每个VC维为 $d$ 的二值概念类都存在大小为 $O(d)$ 的样本压缩方案；一个较弱的猜想只要求方案大小为 $d$ 的多项式。这两个猜想至今仍未解决：第一个仅依赖于 $d$ 的界由Moran和Yehudayoff（2016）给出，但它是 $d$ 的指数级。我们通过构造一个大小为 $O(d^2 \log^2 d)$ 的样本压缩方案，证明了较弱的猜想。
tldr: 本文通过构造大小为 O(d²log²d) 的样本压缩方案，证明了Floyd和Warmuth提出的弱样本压缩猜想，即每个VC维为 d 的二值概念类都存在多项式大小的样本压缩方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proves the weaker Floyd-Warmuth sample compression conjecture by constructing a sample compression scheme of size O(d²log²d), showing that every binary concept class of VC dimension d admits a polynomial-size sample compression scheme.
